say:1:1710533001:1.text: Isn't anyone going to stop this?! I've never lost so badly!
say:1:1710533001:1.source_cn: 有没有人管管啊！我从来没输得这么惨过！

say:2:1710533002:0.text: My tokens... I saved those for half a month...
say:2:1710533002:0.source_cn: 我的青符……我攒了半个月的青符……

say:3:1710533003:0.text: If this keeps up, I'll lose everything!
say:3:1710533003:0.source_cn: 再这样下去我的裤子都要输没了！

say:4:1710533004:0.text: Mei, throw this person out, or I'm done with this place.
say:4:1710533004:0.source_cn: 梅，你得把这个人赶出去！否则我就不玩了。

say:9:1710533006:1.text: To be honest, your current token count still hasn't reached the requirement.
say:9:1710533006:1.source_cn: 这个……恕我直言，您的青符数量暂时还没达到能见馆主的标准。
say:9:1710533006:1.male: To be honest, your current token count still hasn't reached the requirement.
say:9:1710533006:1.female: To be honest, your current token count still hasn't reached the requirement.

say:10:1710533007:1.text: You've won plenty, but you're still below the standard.
say:10:1710533007:1.source_cn: 您确实赢了很多，但距离要求还差一些。
say:10:1710533007:1.male: You've won plenty, but you're still below the standard.
say:10:1710533007:1.female: You've won plenty, but you're still below the standard.

choice_prompt:11:1710533007.text: You've won plenty, but you're still below the standard.
choice_prompt:11:1710533007.source_cn: 您确实赢了很多，但距离要求还差一些。
choice_prompt:11:1710533007.male: You've won plenty, but you're still below the standard.
choice_prompt:11:1710533007.female: You've won plenty, but you're still below the standard.

say:14:1710533009:1.text: You've gotta be kidding me. I can't afford to lose anymore!
say:14:1710533009:1.source_cn: 开什么玩笑？！还要赢？！我已经输不起了！
say:14:1710533009:1.male: You've gotta be kidding me. I can't afford to lose anymore!
say:14:1710533009:1.female: You've gotta be kidding me. I can't afford to lose anymore!

say:16:1710533010:1.text: Wait, let me think of something.
say:16:1710533010:1.male: Wait, let me think of something.
say:16:1710533010:1.female: Wait, let me think of something.

say:17:1710533013:1.text: Give me a moment. I'll need to ask for permission.
say:17:1710533013:1.source_cn: 请给我一点时间，我需要请示一下——
say:17:1710533013:1.male: Give me a moment. I'll need to ask for permission.
say:17:1710533013:1.female: Give me a moment. I'll need to ask for permission.

say:19:1710533011:1.text: Rules are rules. Your tokens are insufficient.
say:19:1710533011:1.source_cn: 您的青符确实数量不足，无论如何，我不能带您去见馆主。
say:19:1710533011:1.male: Rules are rules. Your tokens are insufficient.
say:19:1710533011:1.female: Rules are rules. Your tokens are insufficient.

say:20:1710533012:1.text: But if you really are that determined...
say:20:1710533012:1.male: But if you really are that determined...
say:20:1710533012:1.female: But if you really are that determined...

choice:11:1:2.text: Well, I guess I know what I have to do.
choice:11:1:2.male: Well, I guess I know what I have to do.
choice:11:1:2.female: Well, I guess I know what I have to do.

choice:8:0:1.text: I can see the proprietor now, right?
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 我现在可以见馆主了吧？
choice:8:0:1.male: I can see the proprietor now, right?
choice:8:0:1.female: I can see the proprietor now, right?
